notes.title: The plot has been released for the micro horror puzzle game 'Villa 1'!
notes.content: [p]After a year of development, the storyline for solving the mystery "Villa 1" has finally been released. During this period, we encountered various difficulties, including scripts, art, and programs, but fortunately, we were able to make it in the end[/p][p][/p][p]As our children, we are well aware that it is not perfect and even has various problems, but we still believe that it can provide you with a different experience. We will continue to maintain it in the days to come[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: The final version of Villa No. 1 is here!
notes.content: [p]After more than a month of internal and external testing, Villa 1 has finally reached the time to meet with players. During this period, based on feedback from players, we have fixed the following issues[/p][p]1. The problem of process disorder during the pursuit period[/p][p]2. The problem of chasing for too long[/p][p]3. The problem of misunderstandings caused by TipsMessage[/p][p]4. The multitude of multilingual issues[/p][p]5. Numerous optimization points in the process[/p][p][/p][p]The final version has finally arrived and is expected to be released next[/p][p]Thank you all for your support![/p]

notes.title: Steam New Product Festival Feedback Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216198/9a580c487228a02a80778a8a256efb604a82854c.png[/img]
Hello everyone, we are the TakeTalk development team
During the New Product Festival, hundreds of enthusiastic players tried our game, and we feel very lucky. 

We are also grateful for the many feedbacks provided by our enthusiastic friends, including but not limited to
1. The UI selection suddenly disappears
2. When the UI is opened, movement can also be operated
3. The decryption of the electrical box in the 1st floor distribution room can be repeated
4. Unknown archive issue
wait

We have also made a series of updates to address the above issues. We hope that interested players can download the latest version of the trial version of "Villa 1" to experience it!
Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: The beta version of 'Villa 1' has been released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216198/58242632d46403a2333e7b9356ff404eedc81a9f.png[/img]

After a period of development, testing, and feedback, our beta version has finally been officially released. Our next goal is the New Product Festival in October 2024. We hope everyone can pay attention and provide valuable feedback!

notes.title: 2024 Independent Game Exhibition in the Comic Element Field
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

On October 3-10.4, 2024, the demo version of "Villa 1" will soon participate in the ATMOSPHERE independent game exhibition located in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, at the Norton Hotel in Shenyang, Liaoning Province

I hope friends who have time and energy can participate in the trial offline!

Thank you for your attention. We will continue to refine the existing content and develop the planned content~~

In addition, we will also participate in the Steam New Product Festival on October 13, 2024. Stay tuned!
